triples.head: RuBisCO
triples.evidence: RuBisCO catalyzes a reaction between CO2 and RuBP. For each CO2 molecule that reacts with one RuBP, two molecules of another compound 3-phospho glyceric acid (3-PGA) form.

triples.head: Calvin cycle
triples.evidence: In the stroma, in addition to CO2, two other components are present to initiate the light-independent reactions: an enzyme called ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase (RuBisCO), and three molecules of ribulose bisphosphate (RuBP).

triples.head: Calvin cycle
triples.evidence: The light-independent reactions of the Calvin cycle can be organized into three basic stages: fixation, reduction, and regeneration.
